inlines.v: IMPARTIAL'ITY, noun imparshal'ity. Indifference of opinion or judgment; freedom from bias in favor of one side or party more than another; disinterestedness. Impartiality is indispensable to an upright judge. 1. Equitableness; justice; as the impartiality of a decision.
